snippet.title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros | Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Iron Throne stands empty.

Watch the official Gameplay Reveal Trailer for Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, a real-time strategy game built for PC and developed by PlaySide Studios, coming to Steam in early 2027.

Wishlist the game: https://got.playside.games/swdgCeu

Sign up for the Beta: https://got.playside.games/JFPirKI
